LanguageData.EPG_MeanTimeTooltip: Sets the average interval between ore deposit discoveries. The scanner can find ore sooner by chance; a shorter interval makes discoveries more frequent. Applies to both the powered scanner and the Save Our Ship 2 passive scanner. Minimum: 60 ticks (1 second).
LanguageData.EPG_MaxScanTimeLabel: Maximum time before a guaranteed find: {0}
LanguageData.EPG_MaxScanTimeTooltip: Sets the longest scan interval without a discovery. If no ore is found by this time, the scanner reveals a deposit automatically. Lower values make discoveries more frequent. Applies to both scanner types. Minimum: 60 ticks (1 second).
